title: Honey Whole-Wheat Sandwich Loaf
summary: Wholemeal and white bread flours are soaked with warm milk, water and honey to soften the bran, then kneaded with butter, risen and baked in a tin into a tender, nutty brown loaf.
equipment: stand mixer with dough hook (or large bowl)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Mix the flours with the milk, water and honey, then rest 20 minutes.

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Add the yeast, salt and butter and knead until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Roll up firmly and prove in the buttered tin until risen above the rim.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until well browned and 88-93 °C inside.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Turn out and cool completely before slicing.

tips: The short soak softens the bran so the loaf rises higher and tastes less bitter.
Wholemeal dough stays slightly tacky; resist adding much extra flour.
Tent with foil if the crust browns too quickly; honey makes it colour fast.
storage: Store wrapped at room temperature for up to 3 days, or slice and freeze for up to 1 month and toast from frozen. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
